qualification: Composition metadata only; does not establish serving qualification or general ABI compatibility.

source_overlay: Resolve component commits, trees and patches through source_lock; do not infer compatibility from package version labels.
Compare the vLLM native build inputs named by its source-lock component before reusing inherited extensions; installed payload verification and runtime tests remain required.
Verify the exact installed vLLM files against the SparkCache connector lease contract after applying source overlays.
inherited_native: Reuse these measured libraries only with the pinned foundation and verified installed payload; a matching library hash does not prove compatibility with a different foundation.
Changes to architecture, Python ABI, Torch, CUDA, compiler ABI or native source require an explicit rebuild and compatibility review of affected extensions.
Preserve the selected patched NCCL identity; dependency installation must not silently replace it.
runtime_jit: Use the pinned B12X source composition and its required runtime compiler dependencies.
Treat generated kernel caches as dependent on source, compiler, device and runtime identities; do not transfer qualification from an unrelated cache.
Run GPU correctness and serving checks for generated kernels; source and file hashes alone do not qualify execution.

limitations: Null ABI and GPU values mean unmeasured; they are not wildcard compatibility claims. Measured Python/Torch ABI values are bound by runtime_abi_evidence.
The Torch distribution version is package metadata, not a measurement of its CUDA or C++ ABI.
CUDA Python package versions and filenames are not used to infer the loaded CUDA runtime, toolkit or GPU target.
The inherited_native map records five standalone libraries, not every compiled extension or runtime dependency in the image.
The receipt identifies one measured local candidate image. Rebuilds require fresh receipts and do not inherit its evidence automatically.
This manifest does not describe an SGLang runtime or authorize reuse of AMD64 artifacts on ARM64.
